novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes a “low-dimensional, task-agnostic direction in the residual stream” that is causally responsible for sandbagging, detectable in one pass, and reversible by subtraction, so its novelty route is a sandbagging-specific mechanism and measurement rather than a new setting alone. Searches for “sandbagging activation direction hidden capability elicitation,” “password-locked LLM activation steering,” and “latent knowledge deceptive outputs linear probe” identify Burns et al., Discovering Latent Knowledge in Language Models Without Supervision (2022), Eliciting Latent Knowledge from Quirky Language Models (2023)—which already probes correct knowledge and detects anomalous internal states despite keyword-conditioned false outputs—and Mechanistically Eliciting Latent Behaviors in Language Models (2026), which directly restores password-locked sandbagged capability through internal low-rank perturbations. Moving from those works and established refusal-direction steering to a difference-in-means “effort-gate direction” is a natural extension that changes the behavioral object and intervention parameterization, rather than introducing a fundamentally new relationship; the task-agnostic single-direction prediction is a modest unverified distinction, but probing know-versus-say states and internally reversing hidden behavior are already present in the closest prior work.
